# Headroom

> Headroom is a cognitive load and burnout-risk platform. Take a short assessment to discover your Work Pattern archetype, then sync your calendar to track Core Load, Toxic Load and Growth Load, burnout risk markers, and get AI coaching on a sustainable way of working.

## Pages

- [/](/): Take the free cognitive load assessment and discover your Work Pattern archetype.
- [/evolution](/evolution): How Headroom evolves into a Behavioral OS — the Behavioral Equation of Profit, variable matrix, and worked examples.
- [/evolution/demo](/evolution/demo): Interactive Behavioral OS mockup showing data sources, risk logic, delivery indicators and profit calculation.
- [/login](/login): Sign in with Google or an email magic link.
- [/dashboard](/dashboard): Personal results, cognitive load and burnout risk insights (requires sign-in).
- [/dashboard/calendar](/dashboard/calendar): Upload an .ics calendar for a 90-day cognitive load analysis (requires sign-in).
- [/dashboard/coach](/dashboard/coach): AI coach chat with auto-generated PDF reports (requires sign-in).
- [/privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy, data handling, GDPR/CCPA commitments.

## Concepts

- Core Load: the intrinsic mental effort a task genuinely requires.
- Toxic Load: avoidable overhead — context switching, interruptions, unclear process.
- Growth Load: effort that builds durable skill and capability.
- Burnout Risk: deterministic score derived from calendar density, fragmentation, after-hours work and recovery gaps.
